# Codrill

> Codrill is a free AI mock technical interview tool. You paste a job posting and it generates 5-8 coding questions made for that role, then runs a full interview flow: explain your approach before coding, write real code in an editor, answer follow-up questions about the code you wrote, and get scored on correctness, communication, and reasoning.

## Key facts

- Free to use. No card.
- Works without an account. Sessions are saved in your browser; optional Google sign-in keeps your history across devices.
- Supports JavaScript, Python, and Java in a Monaco-based code editor.
- Optional voice: speak your approach and follow-up answers instead of typing.
- Not a static question bank: every question set is generated from the job posting you provide.
- Daily limits apply to keep it free: a few new sessions per person per day.

## Pages

- [Home](/): title screen, how it works, an example, FAQ.
- [Start a session](/start): paste a job posting to begin.
